banner.title: Keep Your Postcard Memories Organized.
banner.subtitle: Smart OCR recognition to track your mailing journey. Fully local processing to protect your privacy.

features.title: Core Recognition Features
features.subtitle: Easily create digital logs to track your postcard exchanges with ease.

step1.title: Share to App
step1.desc: Select a photo in your gallery and share it directly to the app to start.

step2.title: Smart OCR Scanning
step2.desc: Leading offline OCR automatically extracts dates, locations, and text.

step3.title: Generate Delivery Logs
step3.desc: Automatically match friends and dates to build a structured digital mailing list.

stats.title: Statistics & Insights
stats.subtitle: Tracking every connection, visualizing your journey.

ranking_friends.title: Top Friends Ranking
ranking_friends.desc: Who is your most frequent connection? View intimacy levels based on delivery frequency.

ranking_postcards.title: Most Sent Postcards
ranking_postcards.desc: Which designs are the most popular? Track your favorite styles and themes at a glance.

monthly_trend.title: Monthly Delivery Trends
monthly_trend.desc: Visualize your mailing habits through charts and capture the rhythm of your connections.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Security
privacy.subtitle: Your data stays under your control. We promise:

local_storage.title: 100% Local Storage
local_storage.desc: All recognition history and settings are stored exclusively on your device and are never uploaded to any server.

offline_ocr.title: Offline OCR Technology
offline_ocr.desc: Image recognition is processed entirely on-device. Images are cleared from memory immediately after processing, leaving no digital footprint.

no_tracking.title: Zero Tracking Protection
no_tracking.desc: We do not collect any behavioral data. Your privacy remains secure even when you are offline.

download.title: Download App
download.subTitle: Experience the full feature set on iOS and Android and stay up to date anytime, anywhere.
